strings.For 2D screen mode, fully hold both trig: For 2D screen mode, fully hold both triggers first, then hold L3 for 0.8 seconds. Release all three before repeating. Available during dialogue; close UEVR and leave HUD/mouse adjustment first.
strings.Portal: L3 + LT / F7 | Diorama: L3 + R: Portal: L3 + LT / F7  |  Diorama: L3 + RT  |  2D: hold LT + RT, then L3 for 0.8 s.
strings.Refresh queued; requires the supplied Co: Refresh queued; requires the supplied Comfort script.
strings.Optional workaround, off by default. Rem: Optional workaround, off by default. Removes toon-depth rim lighting from all characters using it, including nearby characters. This hides the observed extra eye contour; it does not repair the underlying stereo cause. Restores the prior value when disabled, in 2D screen mode, or when native VR is inactive.
strings.Requests a bounded cascade-lighting-volu: Requests a bounded cascade-lighting-volume refresh after stereo starts or resumes, after detected teleports, or on request. It helped the tested ship/wheel lighting case; it is not a general fix for dark objects or character rims. Each refill can cause a short hitch.
strings.Rim workaround waits for active native s: Rim workaround waits for active native stereo with 2D screen off.
strings.Rim workaround waits for the current gra: Rim workaround waits for the current graphics comparison to end.
strings.Character toon-depth rim is suppressed;: Character toon-depth rim is suppressed; the previous value is retained.
strings.Character toon-depth rim was already zer: Character toon-depth rim was already zero; no write was needed.
strings.The previous character rim value was res: The previous character rim value was restored and verified.
strings.Rim variable is unavailable. Toggle off,: Rim variable is unavailable. Toggle off, then on to retry.
strings.Rim suppression was not verified. Toggle: Rim suppression was not verified. Toggle off, then on to retry safely.
strings.Rim restoration failed; the original is: Rim restoration failed; the original is retained. Toggle off, then on to retry restoration first.
strings.Another setting changed the rim value; i: Another setting changed the rim value; it was left untouched. Toggle off, then on to retry.
strings.The rim variable changed; no old pointer: The rim variable changed; no old pointer was used. Toggle off, then on to retry.
strings.LT + RT, then hold L3 0.8 s: stereo scre: LT + RT, then hold L3 0.8 s: stereo screen
strings.LT + RT, then click R3: mono theatre: LT + RT, then click R3: mono theatre
strings.Mono theatre on / off (no stereo depth): Mono theatre on / off (no stereo depth)
strings.Fully hold both triggers first: hold L3: Fully hold both triggers first: hold L3 for 0.8 seconds for the stereo screen, or click R3 for mono theatre with no stereo depth. Release all controls and center the sticks before repeating. Available during dialogue; close UEVR and leave HUD/mouse adjustment first.
strings.Mono theatre preserves your stereo-scree: Mono theatre preserves your stereo-screen choice. Turning mono off returns to that choice; it does not change your portal or world scale. This source candidate still needs headset verification.
strings.Portal: L3 + LT / F7 | Diorama: L3 + R: Portal: L3 + LT / F7  |  Diorama: L3 + RT  |  LT + RT: hold L3 = stereo, click R3 = mono.
strings.Mono theatre shows one game image to bot: Mono theatre shows one game image to both eyes. Hold LT + RT, then click R3 to toggle. Turning it off restores the previous view mode.
strings.Automatic mode is off by default. Verifi: Automatic mode is off by default. Verified prerecorded movies use mono; detected story scenes use the choice above. Manual screen toggles override the current scene. Saved portal, scale and view choices are preserved.
strings.Mono theatre also places flat menu backg: Mono theatre also places flat menu backgrounds and controls on one screen. LT + RT, then R3 is the manual fallback; ordinary menus do not trigger automatic cinematic mode.
strings.Hold LT + RT: hold L3 for 0.8 s to toggl: Hold LT + RT: hold L3 for 0.8 s to toggle the screen, or click R3 to toggle mono. Screen off also exits mono. Mono keeps flat menu backgrounds and controls together.
strings.Automatic switching is unverified and of: Automatic switching is unverified and off by default. It is intended to use mono for detected videos and the selected view for story scenes. Manual toggles take priority.
strings.Match cinematic framing between eyes (de: Match cinematic framing between eyes (default on)
strings.Automatic story switching did not activa: Automatic story switching did not activate in the latest reported replay. Prerecorded video switching has not been tested. Missing or changed signals leave the normal view unchanged.
strings.Framing repair matched both eyes in a si: Framing repair matched both eyes in a simulator quest replay. Headset comfort remains untested; mono theatre is still available as a manual fallback.
strings.Armed for UEVR menu navigation. Game inp: Armed for UEVR menu navigation. Game input is paused while this menu is open; release controls after closing it.
strings.Armed: VR controls are being delivered t: Armed: VR controls are being delivered to the selected game controller slot.
strings.For troubleshooting. These controls can: For troubleshooting. These controls can change rendering or input; opening this section changes nothing.
strings.Framing matched both eyes in the owner's: Framing matched both eyes in the owner's simulator replay. Headset comfort and rare prerecorded movies still need testing.
strings.Full animation follows character turns a: Full animation follows character turns and can be intense. L3 + D-pad Down returns to your previous motion choice.
strings.Hold LT + RT: hold L3 for 0.8 s for ster: Hold LT + RT: hold L3 for 0.8 s for stereo screen, or click R3 for mono. Release controls before repeating.
strings.Keeps distant trees and props on the sam: Keeps distant trees and props on the same level of detail in both eyes. This is the normal foliage repair; legacy comparison tests are separate.
strings.Legacy automatic mouse can intercept gam: Legacy automatic mouse can intercept game menu buttons. Manual L3 + LB adjustment remains the normal choice.
strings.Mono preserves your saved stereo-screen: Mono preserves your saved stereo-screen choice; screen off exits both screen modes. Neither changes portal or normal world scale. Manual toggles take priority over automatic cinema for the current scene.
strings.Mono shows the same scene and HUD to bot: Mono shows the same scene and HUD to both eyes. Use it for troublesome cutscenes or flat menus.
strings.Moves supported menus into the VR panel,: Moves supported menus into the VR panel, including with Native Stereo Fix on. The supplied profile enables this. Some flat backgrounds still move separately; mono theatre is the manual fallback.
strings.Off by default. Detected movies are inte: Off by default. Detected movies are intended to use mono; story scenes use your choice above. Recognition remains unverified. Manual view changes take priority.
strings.Recenter keeps world scale and camera of: Recenter keeps world scale and camera offsets. Simulator Home resets only the simulator, not the game's VR origin.
strings.Requests a HUD layout refresh without op: Requests a HUD layout refresh without opening ESC. If this game version is unsupported, the status explains why; saved HUD size and position stay unchanged.
strings.Screen views and cutscene options are in: Screen views and cutscene options are in VR > WuWa Controls > View modes and cutscenes.
strings.The selected treadmill / Xbox slot is di: The selected treadmill / Xbox slot is disconnected. Connect it or choose its connected slot; check launcher Troubleshooting > Controller check.
strings.The supplied profile enables this for Na: The supplied profile enables this for Native Stereo Fix with OpenXR. Headset timing acceptance is still limited; disable only for a deliberate comparison.
strings.These old comparison tests are separate: These old comparison tests are separate from the normal far-object repair. Some deliberately invert or duplicate eye data; they are not recommended player settings.
strings.Uses one game camera pose for both eyes: Uses one game camera pose for both eyes during the same frame, while preserving headset movement and eye separation. Requires Native Stereo Fix. The owner confirmed the ultimate return-to-gameplay fix. Other scene transitions remain under test; this does not repair foliage.
strings.VR controller updates have stopped. No V: VR controller updates have stopped. No VR input is being added; wake both controllers and focus the game.
strings.VR controllers are available. Waiting fo: VR controllers are available. Waiting for the game to poll the selected controller slot before checking readiness.
strings.VR walking input is blocked by Physical: VR walking input is blocked by Physical gamepad passthrough. Turn passthrough off to use VR controllers.
strings.VR walking input is blocked by the contr: VR walking input is blocked by the controller slot filter. Allow the selected walking slot.
strings.VR walking input is paused by the diagno: VR walking input is paused by the diagnostic motion-input mute.
strings.VR walking input requires OpenXR. The cu: VR walking input requires OpenXR. The current runtime is not OpenXR.
strings.Waiting for focused OpenXR and both acti: Waiting for focused OpenXR and both active controllers. No VR input is being added.
strings.Waiting for game focus. Select the game: Waiting for game focus. Select the game window, then release VR controls to arm.
strings.Waiting for release: let go of all VR bu: Waiting for release: let go of all VR buttons and triggers, and center both sticks to arm.
strings.Walk by default; hold RB for normal spee: Walk by default; hold RB for normal speed
strings.With the sheet visible, L3 + D-pad left/: With the sheet visible, L3 + D-pad left/right changes page; L3 + D-pad up returns to automatic. L3 + Menu hides the sheet.
